goal: Recruit sellers: get collectors in Lebanon to list their first card
audience: Trading-card collectors in Lebanon with duplicates or cards to sell
facts: Peer-to-peer: buyers message the seller directly; no checkout
Nothing is taken out of a sale (no commission)
Listing is free for now; paid plans are planned
The site says listing a first card takes about a minute; the sell form has 4 steps: Photos, The card, The deal, Review; 1-8 photos
Games: Pokémon, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana
